findings.statement: Original ARM64 control registration sets Speed to -3..200 ms, default25, with nonlinear normalization: n<.784 => (30625*49^(-n/.784)-625)/150; otherwise -3*(n-.784)/.216. Derived by following Speed string reference through registration, constructor and generic curve instructions; fallback pseudocode leaves FP operations as inline assembly, so raw bytes/disassembly were corroborated.

Original Amount parameter is 0..100 default100, normalized curve112.5*(1-9^(-n)) with midpoint75; Sustain is linear -100..100 default0, and doubler dry/wet and width are linear0..100 default0. These are control mappings, not original DSP formulas.

Original function0xf18b00 wires messages describing positive Sustain as faster retuning of held notes and negative Sustain as slower; original speed messages describe0-20ms robotic correction and harder negative speed. Both reconstructed engines had sustain direction reversed; corrected direction is applied while exact sustain timing and negative-speed DSP remain unresolved.
Width registration block 0xfa2408 uses linear 0..100 conversion with zero physical default. Current VST3 initialization and Default factory presets drifted to70; corrected to0.
